item.description:
Bring together a team of super heroes and prevent Thanos from ending the world! The Infinity Stones are scattered throughout the Multiverse. Use their essence to recruit heroes and villains and gain Infinity Points. Assemble the Avengers, acquire locations and when ready, claim the Infinity Gauntlet! Pick your tokens carefully, recruit characters to gain Infinity Points and bonuses. These bonuses help you recruit more powerful heroes and acquire locations until you gather enough characters, power, and Infinity Points to trigger the endgame!
The core of Splendor: Marvel is still the basic game flow of collecting resources (which are now the Infinity Stones) in order to buy development cards (the ones representing heroes and villains). This version introduces several differences that change the strategic landscape.
Avengers Bonus: Players collect multiple Avengers cards to get a bonus that allows them to focus on certain character sets to get the bonus and also the layer of set collection that goes hand in hand with engine-building.
Shield Bonus: The Shield Bonus allows players either to get extra resources or manipulate the game in their favor. This feature adds a tactical element, because a player must time the use of the Shield Bonus so that they reap the most extensive benefits.
To win, besides scoring a certain number of points (16), the player has to acquire at least one green token and activate the Avengers Bonus.

Players move around a beautifully illustrated 2.5D map, collecting historical landmarks and treasures throughout the ancient city. The game incorporates Xi’an’s iconic cultural sites, such as the Terracotta Army, Bell Tower, and Xi’an Museum.
Additionally, players can unlock unique abilities by claiming historical figures like Qin Shi Huang at the Terracotta Army. They may also travel through time by drawing Dynasty Cards at the Ghost Market, which alters gameplay by adding buffs or debuffs until the card is removed at the Bell Tower.
Victory Conditions
Be the wealthiest player by the end of the game. Collect 10 stars from Treasure Cards to win instantly.

item.description:
스플렌더: Pokémon plays much like the original Splendor game, but with special rules based on Pokémon.
On your turn, you may (1) collect Pokéballs (which come in five colors), or (2) catch a Pokémon, or (3) reserve a Pokémon. If you collect Pokéballs, you take either three different colors of Pokéballs or two Pokéballs of the same color (as long as four are available). If you catch a Pokémon, you pay its cost in Pokéballs, then add it to your playing area. If you reserve a Pokémon — in order to make sure you get it, or, why not, your opponents don't get it — you place it in front of you face down for later catching; this costs you a round, but you also get a Master Ball which you can later use as a Pokéball of any color. Each Pokémon you have caught gives you a permanent Pokéball that you can use toward catching all future Pokémon, meaning as you catch more Pokémon, it becomes easier to catch the ones that are more expensive and worth more points.
Differences from the original Splendor include:
At the end of your turn, you can evolve one of the Pokémon in your collection if the next level of that Pokémon is in the display and you have the required Pokéballs. More points for you, and another card in your Pokédex... There are two new decks of cards: Rare Pokémon and Legendary Pokémon. Only one of each is on display at a time, and they each provide 2 permanent Pokéballs instead of 1 when caught. Legendary Pokémon are worth more points than Rare Pokémon but require you to use a Master Ball in order to catch them.
When a player has 18 or more points in their collection, you complete the final round, then whoever has the most points wins.

item.description:
A Print And Play dice game based on "7 Wonders" by Antoine Bauza from Repos Production. The artwork (for the icons) is based on the original artwork by Miguel Coimbra.
This game was created for the "In-A-Tin" / "Express" Print-and-Play Design Contest - Discussion Thread and shall forever be a free print and play game, by a fan for other fans of the original.
It won the contest (1st Place ("Overall Game"))
Addt'l. categories: 1st Place "Best In-A-Tin Game" 1st Place "Best Express Game" 1st Place "Best Express Game that fits In-A-Tin" 1st Place "Best Solitaire Game" 2nd Place "Game with the Best Cover/Label Art"
Gameplay: Players roll six of the seven dice per round (age). They will reroll first four then two dice. And finally spend the results of the roll on several avenues on the scorecard: War, Victory Points, Wonder Building, everything is possible.
After three rounds (ages) the totals are made and the military strengths are compared - to adjust the final results.
The player with the highest total in victory points is the winner.
Components: 7 Dice. 7 Cards. 1 Scorepad

Rulers - adds a new die to the game, and makes it possible to have rulers in your empire - which can be bribed (taken away) by others.

Teams - adds a corporation between two players (or with the bot) for a combined victory or defeat.
Territory - adds an map for the wonders - first come, first serve.
